'''July 2000 Tempe tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Arizona Gamer on 30 July 2000. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1060">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowedd1060/ arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowed], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-arizona-gamer-randomness-not-allowedd1060/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Arizona Gamer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
